content.text:
The Send message button on the contact page now spans the full width of the form fields. I haven't looked at it in a browser. The 16 functional tests pass.

I added a rule to `site/css/components.css` that makes a button placed directly in a regular form full-width. The newsletter form on the home page shares the `.form` class. I excluded inline forms (`.form-inline`) so the Subscribe button there keeps its current size.

STATUS: DONE
